catalog_review.bf_naming: bf_ + first 20 hex of SHA256(metadata path + null separator + native type); an application naming choice, not a Milvus requirement
catalog_review.platform_mode: Built-in applicability state paired with platform_values: all, specific, unknown. Selecting a specific platform matches all plus overlapping specific values.
catalog_review.finding: Current inference excludes only a partial set of technical keys; passing native filtering does not certify that all inferred columns are meaningful business filters.
catalog_review.recommended_boundary: Keep actual enabled business filter paths, keep platform applicability semantics, present readable labels/mappings. Do not clear or rebuild shared collection automatically.
